title: Hippodamia
summary: Raleigh names Hippodamia in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Hippodamia, wife of Pelops, by whom he had sonnes; named in the Mycenaean king-list. No yeere of the World was taken for her. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XIII, §. IV, sig. 266b
